read.en: Zscaler rose 0.7% on Nov 9 to $199.04, trading between $195.80 and $202.20. It is below the falling 5-day ($210.0) and 10-day ($227.6) and the rising 30-day ($222.1) averages, and above the rising 100-day ($182.0) and 200-day ($167.0). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 2 and has slipped just below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($254.68), and RSI is 38.
read.zh: Zscaler 11月9日上涨 0.7%，收于 $199.04，盘中区间 $195.80–202.20。股价位于下行的 5 日（$210.0）和 10 日均线（$227.6）以及上行的 30 日均线（$222.1）下方，上行的 100 日（$182.0）和 200 日均线（$167.0）上方。MACD 自 11月2日起位于信号线下方，并已略微跌破零轴，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$254.68），RSI 为 38。

read.en: No level changed: the $195.1 support held (Nov 9 low $195.80), and the bounce stayed under $203–203.3. Resistance is $202.2–203.3 (Nov 9 high, Nov 5 and Oct 16 lows), then $210–214.5 (5-day, Nov 6 high, Oct 21 low) and $220.1–222.1 (Nov 3–4 lows, 30-day). Support is $195.1–195.8, then $187.5–187.7 (September lows) and $182.0 (100-day). A close above $203.3 would target $210–214.5; below $195.1, $187.5.
